notes.title: What's next for THIEF'S SHELTER
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing the demo! 

As we get closer to the release date announcement trailer, I want to take a moment to highlight some of the changes we’re working on based on your feedback. Our ultimate goal is to deliver a streamlined experience that everyone can enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a list of some of the upcoming changes:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tool Selection:[/b] Tool selection will no longer require you to hold a button to open a menu and then choose the tool you want. Instead, with a simple press of a button, you’ll be able to toggle between tools.[/p][p][b]Map Rework:[/b] In addition to various fixes, the map will be reworked with improved icons and clearer floor differentiation for easier navigation.[/p][p][b]Shortcuts:[/b] Menus such as the Memoir, Map, Investigation Notes, and Objectives will now be directly accessible through their assigned keys.[/p][p][b]Leaving the Office:[/b] Previously, after obtaining the flashlight, approaching the door would immediately trigger a cutscene, forcing players to leave the area. Now, you’ll need to interact with the door by choice, allowing you to leave whenever you’re ready.[/p][p][b]Music:[/b] We’re introducing enchanting new musical pieces that will elevate [i]Thief’s Shelter[/i] with haunting beauty, weaving emotion and atmosphere into every moment to make your journey more unforgettable than ever.[/p][p][b]Mansion:[/b] The mansion will receive new environmental changes and additional events, making it feel more vivid and alive than ever before.[/p][p][b]Waypoint Visibility Toggle:[/b] For players who want to fully appreciate the beautiful visuals, we’re adding a key to toggle waypoint visibility. With a simple press of a button, you’ll be able to hide waypoints, making it easy to take stunning screenshots or explore the environments without distractions.[/p][p][b]Tutorials:[/b] You’ll now have the option to disable tutorials through the gameplay settings menu, giving you full control over how you experience the game.  [/p][p]
Thank you for sticking with us! Don’t forget to share THIEF'S SHELTER with others to help us reach more players.[/p][p][/p][p]- Dimitris Georgantis[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Join the investigation on our Discord server
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Some of you are already deep in the mystery. We’ve seen some wild theories about what you’ll see in Highburn Mansion! But the demo still holds many secrets…

If you’re playing our Next Fest demo and want to dig deeper, you’re not alone. [b]Join our official Discord server to swap notes, debate what’s real, and meet your fellow detectives![/b]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/vRGTAG3NfA]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url][/b]

As we continue working on Thief’s Shelter, we will also use Discord to post development updates, answer your questions, and share a few secrets about what’s really happening with James and the Red Order. And we might even give away some keys…

[h2]New languages coming at launch[/h2]

We’re excited to announce that Thief’s Shelter will be available in eight additional languages at release, including French, German, Spanish, Greek, Portuguese, Ukrainian, and Simplified Chinese.

And while you’re here… Have you wishlisted Thief’s Shelter? It’s the best way to ensure you don’t miss the launch day.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430930/Thiefs_Shelter/

Come on over to our Discord. It’s time to compare notes!

— Geo Games

notes.title: New Demo & Gameplay Trailer Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39433370/02eceb799617893b1e167c7476bd91110ae4dbc7.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that a new demo for Thief’s Shelter is now available to download right here on Steam! To celebrate, we’re releasing a fresh gameplay trailer featuring new glimpses inside Highburn Mansion — including some of the incredible voice work from our cast.

[previewyoutube=PJ1Zt7Bc1eY;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo covers the opening hours of Thief’s Shelter. It features some of the introductory puzzles, and gives you a good look at core gameplay mechanics — such as James’ Memoir, which you’ll use to log clues, work through puzzles, and track James’ mental state.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430930/Thiefs_Shelter/

If this is your first time hearing about our game: Thief’s Shelter is a first-person mystery that combines puzzles and psychological horror. You play as James, a police detective called to investigate a curious homicide in Highburn Mansion. What he finds inside is a crime scene determined to break his mind.

James suffers from a condition known as ‘artificial dementia’. While inside the mansion, his mental state quickly deteriorates. You’ll see and hear things that aren’t there (or are they?), and discover the mansion itself is changing as you search for answers.

[h2]WISHLIST + SHARE YOUR THEORIES![/h2]

We’d love to hear your thoughts and interpretations after playing the demo. There are more than a few secrets hidden inside… And some of them might take a bit of digging to uncover!

If you want to untangle everything the demo has to offer, join the conversation on our Discord server to connect with other like-minded detectives. And we’d be thrilled to hear your feedback as we move closer to release on Steam and other platforms.

(Like the demo? Please remember to add Thief’s Shelter to your wishlist — this really helps us reach new players. Thanks!)

Remember: the deeper you dig, the less you know what’s real.

— Geo Games
